create_radix_cache_cpp: create a RadixCacheCpp instance with cache init params and server args for hierarchical or non-hierarchical caching
match_prefix_tokens: match a token sequence prefix against the radix tree and return matched device indices and hit length
insert_key_value_pair: insert a RadixKey with token ids and a kv indices tensor into the radix tree
evict_cache_nodes: evict up to a specified number of tokens from the radix tree and free their kv cache pool slots
cache_finished_request: cache a finished request by inserting its committed kv cache indices into the radix tree
cache_unfinished_request: cache an unfinished request by inserting its prefill tokens and updating prefix indices
increment_node_reference: increment the reference count of a radix tree node to prevent premature eviction
decrement_node_reference: decrement the reference count of a radix tree node allowing it to be evicted when unreferenced
reset_radix_cache: reset the radix tree and clear all cached entries
query_cache_sizes: query the evictable, protected, and total sizes of the radix cache
